```{r}
yield_files <- c(
  usa = "usa-bs.csv",
  gbr = "gbr-bs.csv",
  jpn = "jpn-bs.csv",
  cad = "cad-bs.csv",
  ger = "ger-bs.csv",
  fra = "fra-bs.csv"
)

yields <- lapply(yield_files, function(f) {
  read.csv(here::here("reconstructed_data", f))
})

trunc_yields <- lapply(yields, function(x) x[251:500, ])
curves <- c("usa", "gbr", "jpn", "cad", "ger", "fra")
mats <- c(1, 3, 6, 12, 24, 60, 84, 120, 240, 360) 
mat_str <- paste0("X", unlist(lapply(mats, numeric_to_matname)))

```

```{r}
## single curve fitting (baseline)
marginal_DNS <- lapply(trunc_yields, function(x) sc_fit(yields = x, mats = mats, type = c("nelson"), ts = FALSE))

## NS model residuals 
sc_residuals <- setNames(lapply(seq(1:length(yields)), function(x) {
  marginal_DNS[[x]][['yields']] - trunc_yields[[x]][, 2:11]
  }), curves)

## tenor ordering 
wt_list <- setNames(lapply(mat_str, function(tenor) {
  out <- do.call(cbind, lapply(curves, function(ccy) sc_residuals[[ccy]][[tenor]]))
  colnames(out) <- curves
  as.data.frame(out)
  }), paste0("wt_", mat_str))

```

```{r}
## rolling window correlation matrix construction  
build_rolling_corr_array <- function(wt_df, width = 60, min_obs = NULL, align = "right") {
  wt_mat <- as.matrix(wt_df)
  if (is.null(min_obs)) {
    min_obs <- width
  }
  
  if (width < 2) {
    stop("Rolling window width must be at least 2.")
  }
  
  if (min_obs < 2 || min_obs > width) {
    stop("min_obs must satisfy 2 <= min_obs <= width.")
  }
  
  n <- nrow(wt_mat)
  corr_path <- vector("list", n)
  curve_names <- colnames(wt_mat)
  
  for (i in seq_len(n)) {
    if (align == "right") {
      idx <- max(1, i - width + 1):i
    } else if (align == "center") {
      half_window <- floor((width - 1) / 2)
      idx <- max(1, i - half_window):min(n, i + half_window)
    } else if (align == "left") {
      idx <- i:min(n, i + width - 1)
    } else {
      stop("align must be one of 'right', 'center', or 'left'.")
    }
    
    if (length(idx) < min_obs) {
      corr_path[[i]] <- NA
    } else {
      corr_path[[i]] <- stats::cor(wt_mat[idx, , drop = FALSE], use = "pairwise.complete.obs")
      rownames(corr_path[[i]]) <- curve_names
      colnames(corr_path[[i]]) <- curve_names
    }
  }
  
  return(corr_path)
}

## visualization formatting 
rolling_corr_long <- function(wt_df, time_index, width = 60, min_obs = NULL, upper_only = TRUE) {
  corr_path <- build_rolling_corr_array(wt_df = wt_df, width = width, min_obs = min_obs)
  
  curve_names <- colnames(wt_df)
  p <- length(curve_names)
  
  # Build pair grid in matrix-display order
  if (upper_only) {
    pair_grid <- do.call(
      rbind,
      lapply(seq_len(p - 1), function(i) {
        data.frame(
          row = curve_names[i],
          col = curve_names[(i + 1):p],
          stringsAsFactors = FALSE
        )
      })
    )
  } else {
    pair_grid <- do.call(
      rbind,
      lapply(seq_len(p), function(i) {
        data.frame(
          row = curve_names[i],
          col = curve_names,
          stringsAsFactors = FALSE
        )
      })
    )
  }
  
  pair_levels <- paste(pair_grid$row, pair_grid$col, sep = " / ")
  
  corr_long <- purrr::map_dfr(seq_along(corr_path), function(i) {
    corr_i <- corr_path[[i]]
    
    if (length(corr_i) == 1 && all(is.na(corr_i))) {
      return(NULL)
    }
    
    tibble::tibble(time = time_index[i], row = pair_grid$row, col = pair_grid$col,
                   correlation = purrr::map2_dbl(pair_grid$row, pair_grid$col, function(r, c) corr_i[r, c]))
  })
  
  dplyr::mutate(corr_long, pair = factor(paste(row, col, sep = " / "), levels = rev(pair_levels)))
}

plot_rolling_corr_heatmap <- function(wt_df, time_index, width = 60, min_obs = NULL,
                                      upper_only = TRUE, title = NULL) {
  corr_long <- rolling_corr_long(
    wt_df = wt_df, time_index = time_index,
    width = width, min_obs = min_obs,
    upper_only = upper_only
  )
  
  ggplot2::ggplot(corr_long, ggplot2::aes(x = time, y = pair, fill = correlation)) +
    ggplot2::geom_tile() +
    ggplot2::scale_fill_gradient2(
      low = "red",
      mid = "white",
      high = "blue",
      midpoint = 0,
      limits = c(-1, 1)
    ) +
    ggplot2::labs(
      title = title,
      x = "Time Index",
      y = "Curve pair",
      fill = "Corr"
    ) +
    ggplot2::theme_minimal() +
    ggplot2::theme(
      panel.grid = ggplot2::element_blank(),
      axis.text.x = ggplot2::element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1)
    )
}

plot_wt_correlations <- function(wt_list, time_index, width = 60, tenors = names(wt_list)) {
  stats::setNames(
    lapply(tenors, function(tenor_name) {
      plot_rolling_corr_heatmap(
        wt_df = wt_list[[tenor_name]],
        time_index = time_index,
        width = width,
        title = paste("Rolling cross-curve correlations:", tenor_name)
      )
    }),
    return(tenors)
  )
}
```

```{r}
## individual plotting 
time_index <- seq(1:length(trunc_yields[[1]]$time))

plot_rolling_corr_heatmap(
  wt_df = wt_list$wt_X01M,
  time_index = time_index,
  width = 50,
  title = "50-day rolling cross-curve correlations for X01M tenor"
)
```

```{r}
## group plotting 
tenor_corr_plots <- plot_wt_correlations(
  wt_list = wt_list,
  time_index = time_index,
  width = 30,
  tenors = paste0("wt_", mat_str)
)
```

```{r}
## correlation matrix significance testing
rolling_corrs <- lapply(wt_list, function(x) {
  corr_arr <- build_rolling_corr_array(x, width = 50)
  corr_arr <- Filter(function(x) !all(is.na(x)), corr_arr)
  return(corr_arr) 
})

## likelihood ratio test

## Bartlett's sphericity test 
combo_bartlett <- function(corr_array, width) {
  lapply(corr_array, function(x) psych::cortest.bartlett(x, n = width))
}

bartlett_vals <- lapply(rolling_corrs, function(x) combo_bartlett(x, width=50))
bartlett_signif <- unlist(lapply(bartlett_vals$wt_X10Y, function(x) x[2]))
```
